response.text:
I can do that — but cancelling calendar events is destructive, so I need a couple quick confirmations first.

1) Which exact scope do you want?
   - Cancel the entire recurring series (all past + future Thursdays), or
   - Cancel all future Thursday occurrences only, or
   - Cancel only the next Thursday occurrence?

2) Do you want me to notify attendees with a cancellation (and include an optional message), or just remove it from your calendar without sending a notice?

3) Do you want me to remove any conferencing links (Zoom/Meet) and location when cancelling?

If you’d like, I can first look up the matching “Release standup” Thursday event(s) on your calendar and show the title, time, attendees, time zone, recurrence, and conferencing before making any change — then you can confirm which one to cancel. Should I look it up now? If yes, do you prefer I cancel the whole series or just future occurrences once I find it?
